category.title: ActionScript 2
category.description: Tracked families of language features and Flash APIs. The completed share of this registry is not a percentage of Flash Player compatibility.

features.title: Source diagnostics
features.scope: Parse errors and unsupported frontend constructs report the language, line and column; compilation errors block export.
features.limitations: This guarantees compiler diagnostics, not verification of every Flash API semantic.

features.title: Literals
features.scope: Decimal, hexadecimal and exponent numbers; strings; Boolean, null, undefined, NaN and Infinity; arrays without holes and object literals.
features.limitations: The full set of literals and historical Flash rules is not implemented; legacy numbers with leading zeroes are rejected.

features.title: Variables and scope
features.scope: var, multiple declarations, handler-owner fields, and hoisting of local var declarations and parameters.
features.limitations: Handler fields differ from classes and the full Flash scope chain; top-level declarations follow documented reinitialization rules.

features.title: Arithmetic, logic and assignments
features.scope: Basic arithmetic, comparisons, short-circuit evaluation, bitwise operations, ++/-- and compound assignments. Membership and member/index deletion preserve original container keys; indexed compound/update writes evaluate receiver and key once.
features.limitations: Some operations use JavaScript coercion; this is not complete AVM semantics across all Flash Player versions.

features.title: If/else branches
features.scope: Parsing and execution of if/else, blocks and the conditional expression ?:, selecting one branch.
features.limitations: This covers control flow in the supported frontend; conversion of arbitrary Flash objects remains part of unfinished type compatibility.

features.title: Classic loops and jumps
features.scope: while, do/while, three-part for, and nested break/continue with jump-target validation.
features.limitations: for..in property enumeration and full compatibility of condition coercion are tracked separately. Independent a3fedc3 browser evidence covers the specific class/input scenarios in VERIFICATION.md; all untested members remain bounded or unverified.

features.title: Switch and fallthrough
features.scope: Single evaluation of the subject, sequential case matching, default, fallthrough and break.
features.limitations: The supported contract uses strict comparison; compatibility across Flash Player versions is not certified.

features.title: Function declarations and calls
features.scope: Function declarations and expressions, recursion, mutual recursion, return, callbacks and immediately invoked function expressions. Bounded runtime lookup of user-defined timeline callbacks and capture of the timeline where the function was defined.
features.limitations: Declarations must be directly inside a function or handler body; there is no general project resolver. Missing or non-callable functions and unsupported native goto aliases produce diagnostics; complete AVM1 lookup and ordering are not reproduced.

features.title: Closures and variable capture
features.scope: Lexical local variables, shadowing, closures retained after return, and capture of the handler owner.
features.limitations: The complete Flash receiver, global-object and scope-chain models are not implemented.

features.title: Function parameters and returns
features.scope: Positional parameters; AS2 annotations are erased; missing and extra arguments follow JavaScript behavior.
features.limitations: Default/rest parameters, arguments and general Function.call/apply are absent; full compatibility of types and invocation errors is unproven.

features.title: this and method binding
features.scope: Frame/object handlers retain their owner. Declared AS2 class methods are shared and unbound, using their actual call receiver; function expressions can use explicit dynamic this. Listener callbacks retain their listener object.
features.limitations: Bare owner fields in older handler closures still use the captured timeline owner. Complete AVM1 scope-chain/global-receiver semantics and reflection remain incomplete.

features.title: Annotations and type system
features.scope: Selected primitive and resolved project-class annotations are accepted and erased. AS2 class fields without initializers default to undefined; writes do not acquire AS3-style slot coercion. LoadVars annotations are accepted and erased; its hidden constructor binding does not replace local source bindings.
features.limitations: There is no complete AS2 static type checker or VM coercion model. Erased class annotations intentionally do not enforce assignment types at runtime. Independent c39a29e acceptance (RESOURCES-HTML5-20261027T0323Z) covers the precise embedded/HTTP and pending-request observations in VERIFICATION.md; native resource authoring and full network semantics remain unverified.

features.title: Throw, catch and finally
features.scope: Explicit throw preserving the payload, untyped catch and catch(Error), finally and rethrow.
features.limitations: AS2 catch does not intercept native JavaScript/host errors; catch bindings and variable capture have restrictions.

features.title: Error objects
features.scope: A limited new Error facade, message and toString.
features.limitations: General class construction, getStackTrace, complete prototype semantics and all Flash error codes are absent.

features.title: Classes, inheritance and interfaces
features.scope: One qualified class per matching source path; public/default instance/static members, scalar prototype defaults, same-dialect inheritance/super, shared unbound writable methods and constructor-created objects. Existing instances observe prototype method replacement.
features.limitations: Interfaces/accessors, nonpublic access control, non-scalar inline defaults, mixed-dialect inheritance, class-as-function casts and unsupported super value extraction diagnose. Complete prototype/reflection, construction and static initialization order are pending. Independent a3fedc3 browser evidence covers the specific class/input scenarios in VERIFICATION.md; all untested members remain bounded or unverified. The linked-movieclips ordinary-export/real-WASM host scenario passes; representative interactions and Restart also passed in the shared in-app-browser batch; VERIFICATION.md distinguishes visible evidence from host-only checks. Independent 798e28b evidence (LINKED-INTERFACES-HTML5-20261027T0243Z) applies only to the linked timeline and interface/accessor observations in VERIFICATION.md. AS2 host-error catch recovery, complete construction order and uncalled members remain unverified or outside the supported profile.

features.title: Imports and project linking
features.scope: Embedded AS2 sources support exact imports, same-package/qualified resolution and linked authored symbols. Class source paths match qualified names; the root document_class option is a NeoFlash extension. Explicit library linkage IDs connect runtime creation to authored MovieClip symbols; exported linked classes must ultimately extend MovieClip.
features.limitations: Wildcard and mixed-dialect imports, ambient filesystem/module loading and SWC dependencies are unsupported. Source compilation does not add FLA/XFL linkage extraction or a complete legacy linker. The linked-movieclips ordinary-export/real-WASM host scenario passes; representative interactions and Restart also passed in the shared in-app-browser batch; VERIFICATION.md distinguishes visible evidence from host-only checks.

features.title: Dynamic objects and prototypes
features.scope: Object literals, custom fields, property/index reads and explicitly defined function members.
features.limitations: There is no complete Object/prototype/scope-chain model; computed calls, general alias/type inference and some dynamic methods are rejected.

features.title: Property enumeration and with
features.scope: Bounded for-in property enumeration over ordinary records, Arrays and project objects; original-key membership and member/index deletion. AS2 variable annotations retain their erased profile.
features.limitations: Snapshot keys ignore later insertions, skip deletions and read values at visit time. Historical iteration order, with, XML/E4X and enumeration of hidden native/display storage remain unsupported. The combined typed-collections workflow supplies delivery evidence separately; this is not a full Flash enumeration contract. Independent 6396fd0 evidence (TYPED-COLLECTIONS-HTML5-20261027T0525Z) covers only the ordinary AS2 record for-in total in the inventory scenario and its Restart in VERIFICATION.md. It does not imply AS2 native Vector/Dictionary/for-each, native-storage enumeration or general historical enumeration order.

features.title: Additional language operators
features.scope: instanceof, in, delete, unary void and general new.
features.limitations: These are rejected with diagnostics; the separate new Error facade does not complete this capability.

features.title: Primitives and global conversions
features.scope: Number, Boolean, parseFloat, isNaN and isFinite retain JavaScript-backed conversions. String now uses the bounded primitive family facade; parseInt retains its separate pinned AS2 profile and earlier HTML5 acceptance. Bare getTimer() reads signed 32-bit elapsed milliseconds from the publication session clock.
features.limitations: Complete historical coercions, boxed values and the full standard library remain unfinished. Array/String expectations are documented_only; the combined browser pipeline passed without original Flash comparison. Restart rebases the clock; this does not add AS2 interval/timeout APIs or establish historical timing equivalence. The combined geometry/clock browser workflow and Restart passed.

features.title: Math
features.scope: A closed list of numeric Math methods, including trigonometry, abs, min/max, pow, random and round. Exact project imports also expose finite Point/Rectangle/Matrix values: point arithmetic, rectangle queries and affine matrix construction/composition/inversion/coordinate mapping. Display bounds and coordinate conversion use the same value classes. Runtime Transform/ColorTransform adds exact affine overrides, copy-valued geometry getters, skew-preserving scalar mutation, nested RGBA paint composition and independent tinted views of shared pixels.
features.limitations: Execution is delegated to JavaScript; the full contract and numerical equivalence with Flash are not certified. The shared geometry profile requires finite numbers and rejects overflow/singular inversion; 3D values and complete historical coercion/native-slot behavior remain pending. Runtime Transform uses logical stage coordinates and bounded finite values; native script preview/authoring skew, browser-window mapping and exact raster pixelBounds are not claimed. The combined geometry/Timer browser workflow and Restart passed. The combined Transform workflow passed actual-WASM and in-app-browser Cycle/Restart; independent declaration audit and exact historical conformance remain separate.

features.title: Collections, strings, dates and data APIs
features.scope: Bounded Array constructors and mutation/slicing, comparator/flag sort and multi-field sortOn; primitive String conversion, UTF-16 access/search/slicing/splitting/concatenation/casing. Shared adapters preserve custom overrides and lookup order in handlers and project methods. AS2 Number formatting and the Array search extension remain JavaScript-backed rather than complete native AS2 contracts. Date adds current/millisecond/component construction, UTC/local getters and setters, static UTC/parse, modern browser date strings and native-branded values shared between compiled units.
features.limitations: Partial profiles: 1,000,000 array entries/string code units or results; ordinary records, restricted sortOn options, no native method extraction/prototype augmentation, RegExp/custom string patterns, locale operations or complete historical coercion/order. AS3 NUMERIC requires numeric values; AS2 boxed String is unsupported. See fixture profile constants for exact dialect limits. The combined collection/text browser scenario passed; this does not establish every method. Date uses the modern browser calendar/parser/locale backend; complete historical coercion/DST/formatting and native subclasses remain unsupported. Native RegExp and JSON are AS3-only; user AS2 classes with those names retain their ordinary resolution. Initial data-processing delivery verification is recorded separately. Independent 7ed1605 evidence (DATA-HTML5-20261027T0452Z) covers only numeric UTC Date construction/mutation/readback in the separate AS2 card and Restart, as scoped in VERIFICATION.md. It does not imply native AS2 JSON/RegExp or locale/DST/parsing conformance.

features.title: Trace through the browser host
features.scope: trace from handlers and nested functions runs through the host, updating the console and player status line.
features.limitations: This implements the observable NeoFlash output channel; complete formatting of all Flash types is not claimed.

features.title: MovieClip and timelines
features.scope: play/stop, gotoAndPlay/gotoAndStop and nextFrame/prevFrame return undefined; current/total frames, named children and independent nested clocks remain available. AS2 labels use ASCII folding, first duplicate match and missing-label no-op; bounded numeric strings take precedence. Linked AS2 MovieClip classes retain the same captured timeline bridge and per-placement lifetime. Explicitly exported MovieClip symbols provide independent scoped authored timelines, nested clocks/scripts and linked class state; attachMovie resolves an exact export identifier at append-only depth with a bounded data-only initObject.
features.limitations: This is a limited MovieClip facade; complete construction/re-entry, scenes, unrestricted authored-list mutation and the Flash lifecycle are not implemented. Native goto aliases and complete historical numeric and lookup rules are unsupported. Independent a3fedc3 browser evidence covers the specific class/input scenarios in VERIFICATION.md; all untested members remain bounded or unverified. The linked-movieclips ordinary-export/real-WASM host scenario passes; representative interactions and Restart also passed in the shared in-app-browser batch; VERIFICATION.md distinguishes visible evidence from host-only checks. Independent 798e28b evidence (LINKED-INTERFACES-HTML5-20261027T0243Z) applies only to the linked timeline and interface/accessor observations in VERIFICATION.md. AS2 host-error catch recovery, complete construction order and uncalled members remain unverified or outside the supported profile.

features.title: Display properties
features.scope: Position, scale, alpha, bounded finite rotation readback, visibility, root/parent and AS2 aliases including _name/_width/_height. The shared facade supplies name lookup, transformed bounds/coordinates and supported nonrotated dimension changes. Runtime createEmptyMovieClip/removeMovieClip and append-only getNextHighestDepth share stable identities with the dynamic graph. Explicitly exported MovieClip symbols provide independent scoped authored timelines, nested clocks/scripts and linked class state; attachMovie resolves an exact export identifier at append-only depth with a bounded data-only initObject. MovieClip.attachBitmap adds shared runtime pixels at the current append depth. Runtime Transform/ColorTransform adds exact affine overrides, copy-valued geometry getters, skew-preserving scalar mutation, nested RGBA paint composition and independent tinted views of shared pixels. Runtime vector mask assignment and copied integral scrollRect state clip nested targets while preserving live identities; content coordinate offsets and viewport bounds share the Rust graph.
features.limitations: Full MovieClip APIs, general depth management, alpha masks/filters and TextField/Button contracts remain incomplete. Rotated dimension writes and noninvertible coordinate conversions diagnose; legacy rotation/visibility coercion is not full AVM1 conformance. Representative family behavior passed in the shared in-app-browser batch; this is not full API or cross-engine acceptance. Independent a3fedc3 browser evidence covers the specific class/input scenarios in VERIFICATION.md; all untested members remain bounded or unverified. Authored children cannot be moved/removed; detached runtime objects remain allocated until Restart, with a 4,096-object bound. General Flash depth replacement and full linked construction order remain unsupported. The combined dynamic-display browser workflow and Restart passed. Independent 2b5deff evidence covers only the exact dynamic drawing/identity or binary packet scenarios in VERIFICATION.md; other members and native error/coercion fidelity remain unverified. The linked-movieclips ordinary-export/real-WASM host scenario passes; representative interactions and Restart also passed in the shared in-app-browser batch; VERIFICATION.md distinguishes visible evidence from host-only checks. Independent 798e28b evidence (LINKED-INTERFACES-HTML5-20261027T0243Z) applies only to the linked timeline and interface/accessor observations in VERIFICATION.md. AS2 host-error catch recovery, complete construction order and uncalled members remain unverified or outside the supported profile. The bitmap-pixels family passes separate ordinary-export/real-WASM and in-app-browser checks for visible shared edits, source/clone independence, AS2 attachment and Restart. Native image-panel acceptance remains pending; full rasterization and coercion parity are not established. Independent 1bd0e3c evidence (BITMAP-HTML5-20261027T0345Z) is restricted to the PNG/shared pixel, AS2 attachment, disposal and Restart observations in VERIFICATION.md. JPEG, rasterization options, alpha hits and native image authoring do not inherit that pass. The combined Transform workflow passed actual-WASM and in-app-browser Cycle/Restart; independent declaration audit and exact historical conformance remain separate. Independent 852c8b7 evidence (TRANSFORMS-HTML5-20261027T0502Z) covers the specified affine/skew/reparent, tint/alpha pixels and real coordinate hits, copy ownership and Restart workflow in VERIFICATION.md. Native editing, exact rasterization, dynamic-card keyboard/accessibility and unobserved members do not inherit that pass. Canonical ColorTransform.rgb remains missing: P1 TRANSFORM-AS2-RGB-001 reproduces a silent custom-field write with unchanged green tint; the adjacent .color control produces red. Working AS2 affine stripe/rotation does not close rgb. Vector-only/static source restrictions and immediate integral scroll rectangles are explicit; native clipping authoring and historical fractional/deferred behavior remain pending. Independent 05d5d43 evidence (CLIPPING-HTML5-20261027T0652Z) covers direct-object setMask, the observed Boolean success/clear/restore and real excluded/positive legacy input, finite integral scroll offsets and the narrow absent-scrollRect undefined profile in VERIFICATION.md. AS3 copy checks do not establish AS2 getter-copy behavior. Historical return/coercion, source reuse/retirement and uncalled members remain unverified.

features.title: Events and handlers
features.scope: Authored handlers and onEnterFrame/onPress callbacks include live inherited AS2 prototype lookup. Captured Key/Mouse/Stage singletons provide object listeners, keyboard state, mouse visibility and logical resize with snapshot/reset/lifetime cleanup.
features.limitations: Other native callbacks, AsBroadcaster, Selection, source on/onClipEvent wrappers, toggled-key/cross-domain/IME behavior and exact Flash lifecycle ordering remain pending. ASCII/layout and logical Stage resize are bounded browser profiles; representative coordinate clicks, keyboard and Restart passed in the AS2 browser batch. Independent a3fedc3 browser evidence covers the specific class/input scenarios in VERIFICATION.md; all untested members remain bounded or unverified.

features.title: Programmatic drawing
features.scope: Runtime MovieClips expose solid/linear/radial gradient fill and stroke with native Matrix values and percentage alpha through the shared Rust scene. Lines, quadratic paths, clear and existing dynamic identity behavior remain available.
features.limitations: Initial gradients support pad/rgb, 1..15 ordered stops, copied finite invertible matrices and focal ratios within -1..1. Authored-owner drawing, hairlines, non-round stroke modes, bitmap fills, alpha masks/filters, native gradient tools and full historical paint/coercion semantics remain pending. Storage is bounded; prior independent solid-drawing evidence does not promote the new gradient declarations. Independent 08f1d9c evidence (GRAPHICS-HTML5-20261027T0619Z) covers only the actual AS2 gradient triangle, authored press callback and related Restart workflow in VERIFICATION.md. It does not promote all legacy drawing members or historical gradient/coercion behavior.

features.title: TextField and text APIs
features.scope: Plain authored and runtime-created text fields share Rust text/layout state: AS2 createTextField at append-only depth and captured global TextFormat, with getNewTextFormat/setNewTextFormat aliases. Independent logical boxes, multiline/wordWrap, left/center/right alignment, uniform font/size/color/bold/italic/leading, separate current/insertion defaults, text/append/replace and UTF-16 line queries/metrics.
features.limitations: Whole-field formatting only; differing insertion defaults cannot append/partially replace nonempty text without mixed-run support. No HTML/CSS, input/selection/IME, embedded fonts, advanced paragraph formats, justified alignment or native text subclass initialization. Text is bounded to 1 MiB UTF-8 per field, 16 MiB runtime override storage and 16,384 layout segments/lines, with complete Unicode replacement ranges. Long-token wrapping uses Unicode scalar boundaries, not grapheme segmentation. Installed-font measurements and shared Rust wrapping do not establish Flash layout/coercion parity. The earlier collection/text browser scenario retains its bounded evidence; the new text-layout ordinary-export/real-WASM workflow passes creation, reflow, independent formats, drawing/clip consumption, atomic mixed-run refusal and Restart. The in-app-browser workflow visibly passed reflow/alignment, independent fields and Restart; native interactive editing remains pending. Independent fba17ae evidence (TEXT-LAYOUT-HTML5-20261027T0409Z) covers only the actual uniform layout/format/refusal/Restart workflow in VERIFICATION.md. Native live editing, other fonts/engines, mixed runs and input/IME do not inherit the browser pass.

features.title: Audio, video and resource loading
features.scope: Authored embedded PNG/JPEG image placements use shared Rust decoding. BitmapData supports construction, pixel reads/writes, fillRect/copyPixels, clone/scroll and disposal over the shared pixel arena. AS2 exact BitmapData import, rectangle alias and append-depth MovieClip.attachBitmap share that buffer profile. Captured AS2 Sound supports non-streaming loadSound, seconds-based start, owned-channel stop, percentage volume/pan, byte counts and receiver-bound load/completion callbacks. Shared MP3/WAV preflight and publication-owned Web Audio lifecycle gate playback on user activation.
features.limitations: Video, general Loader/image networking, BitmapData.loadBitmap linkage, draw/filter/shader/encode, bitmap fills, alpha masks, lock/unlock and native Bitmap/BitmapData subclasses remain unsupported. Pixel adapters require integer coordinates/uint colors; historical error/coercion/rasterization fidelity is not claimed. The combined bitmap-pixels ordinary-export/real-WASM scenario passes original PNG decoding, shared/independent buffers, both dialects, actual RGBA uploads, smoothing/snapping, disposal and Restart. The in-app-browser workflow visibly passed shared edits, source/clone independence, AS2 attachment and Restart; native image-panel interaction remains pending. Disposed/invalid access uses shared errors, not historical AS2 numeric sentinel values; Flash depth replacement is unsupported. Dimensions are bounded to 4096 per side, 256 buffer records per publication and 128 MiB live pixels; disposal releases bytes but keeps its record until Restart. Native PNG/JPEG placement is implemented with UI acceptance pending; other image formats remain storage only. Independent 1bd0e3c evidence (BITMAP-HTML5-20261027T0345Z) is restricted to the PNG/shared pixel, AS2 attachment, disposal and Restart observations in VERIFICATION.md. JPEG, rasterization options, alpha hits and native image authoring do not inherit that pass. Audio is a bounded browser profile, not full Flash mixing/coercion: no streaming, SoundLoaderContext, ID3/sampleData/extract, mixer/target hierarchy, native audio subclasses or timeline audio authoring. Limits are 128 MiB decoded/pending PCM, 32 channels and 256 Sound owners. One original-MP3 ordinary-export/real-WASM scenario passes transport/preflight, silent gesture scheduling, transforms, callbacks/stop/close and Restart with an injected AudioContext; A separate main-delivery in-app-browser pass verifies actual MP3 decoding/offline PCM, silent native lifecycle and the ordinary AS2/AS3 Play/Stop/Restart workflow; WAV native decode and historical mixer fidelity remain unverified. Independent d8f580a evidence (AUDIO-HTML5-20261027T0429Z) covers only the embedded-AS3/HTTP-AS2 original-MP3 workflow, silent native completion with bounded repeats, transform copy/refusal, active Stop and publication Restart in VERIFICATION.md. It does not inherit the separate main-delivery offline PCM probe or establish audible quality, native WAV decoding, nonzero offsets/gain, full mixer semantics or pending-decode races.

features.title: Networking, storage and external communication
features.scope: Captured AS2 LoadVars with decode/toString, erased annotations, byte counters, GET load, GET/POST sendAndLoad, request headers and actual-receiver onData/onLoad/onHTTPStatus callbacks. Embedded version-3 project resources resolve offline; external HTTP(S) uses browser fetch/CORS. Cancellation and publication reset suppress obsolete work. MovieClipLoader adds resource/HTTP PNG/JPEG loadClip, listener callbacks, getProgress and unloadClip with true non-root MovieClip content replacement.
features.limitations: Bounded UTF-8/form profile and browser transport semantics, not complete Flash networking/security/error conformance. Native subclasses, filesystem loading, multipart/file uploads, sockets, URLStream, AMF/SharedObject, automatic retry/timeout policy and browser-navigation LoadVars.send remain unsupported. Limits: 16 MiB body/response, 64 MiB active response bytes, 32 concurrent operations, 1024 form pairs and 64 request headers. One combined ordinary-export/real-WASM resource-loading scenario passed embedded data, emitted AS3/AS2 HTTP POST through actual local fetch, cancellation and Restart. The embedded pipeline, same-origin HTTP GET and Restart passed in the in-app browser. Native resource-panel and direct-file browser opening remain pending; cross-origin browser CORS was not separately exercised. Independent c39a29e acceptance (RESOURCES-HTML5-20261027T0323Z) covers the precise embedded/HTTP and pending-request observations in VERIFICATION.md; native resource authoring and full network semantics remain unverified. Image loading excludes SWF/GIF, application/security domains, native Loader subclasses and general legacy target addressing. Retained AS3 content survives unload; explicit disposal/Restart and shared arena limits apply while full garbage collection remains pending. The loader-gallery delivery has separate evidence; previous resource/bitmap audits do not promote new loader declarations.

features.title: Components and platform libraries
features.scope: AS2 UI/component libraries and related Flash platform APIs.
features.limitations: These libraries are not implemented; porting platform APIs requires an explicit supported/adapted/unavailable contract.

features.title: Complete virtual-machine semantics
features.scope: AVM1 compatibility, including Flash Player versions, coercion, scope chains and runtime errors.
features.limitations: The current frontend emits JavaScript; internal regression tests are not Flash Player conformance certification.

features.title: Debugger and source maps
features.scope: ActionScript debugging with original source lines, breakpoints and state inspection.
features.limitations: Compile/publish diagnostics exist; a complete source debugger is absent.

features.title: Source on / onClipEvent wrappers
features.scope: Parsing legacy object-script wrappers and compatible AS2 event registration.
features.limitations: The editor event selector accepts only a handler body; source wrappers are unsupported. Independent a3fedc3 browser evidence covers the specific class/input scenarios in VERIFICATION.md; all untested members remain bounded or unverified.

features.title: XML
features.scope: XML/XMLNode constructors and strict shared Rust parsing; DOM traversal, individual attributes/text, clone/move/remove, serialization and namespace preservation. XML.load reuses URLLoader with legacy callbacks/byte counters and publication lifetime.
features.limitations: This is a bounded XML1.0 UTF-8 profile, separate from XFL parsing. DTD/custom entities, declaration/namespace mutation, send/sendAndLoad and full legacy status/coercion/partial-tree recovery remain unsupported. Strict syntax/namespace/character failure sets -6 and preserves prior content; other unsupported forms diagnose. Detached nodes count against publication bounds until Restart. Combined delivery evidence does not imply independent per-declaration audit or original-player conformance. Independent f4fcb71 evidence (XML-HTML5-20261027T0545Z) covers only the actual embedded-resource tree/catalog workflow, full logical-tree comparisons, copy/mutation/serialization and Restart in VERIFICATION.md. It does not imply byte-identical serialization syntax, full historical parser/coercion behavior or later E4X syntax. Direct parseXML remains needs_review: only malformed-input status -6 with the previous safe tree preserved was independently observed. Independent 5be13d9 regression evidence (E4X-HTML5-20261027T0608Z) preserves the same three-item AS2 catalog tree mutations/totals and Restart in VERIFICATION.md. It does not establish positive direct parseXML or AS2 E4X support.
